document.abstract: Edit. Note: During the Society's Technical Conference in New York, 29 October to 3 November 1978, a panel discussion was arranged to conclude the Digital Television Session on Wednesday morning, 1 November. The panel was comprised of authors of participating papers in that session and representatives of the SMPTE Study Group on Digital Television and of the Working Group on Digital Video Standards. Panelists and their affiliations are listed below.
